metadata.description:
The Clubhouse sits on the highest point in Jones County at 300 feet above sea level.  Holes 1, 2, & 3 wind their way down from the clubhouse to 200 feet above sea level.  Holes 4 & 5 play level with a slight elevation into five green.  
Hole 6 plays along a ridge at 250 feet above sea level.  Holes 7 & 8 are level with challenging driving areas.  Hole 9 gradually climbs back to the clubhouse with the green at 240 feet above sea level.  Hole 10 plays downhill to the dogleg left fairway and across a low fairway to an elevated green.  Hole 11 will crossover a lake to a dogleg night fairway down a ridge to the green.  Hole 12 plays back across the same lake to a well bunkered green.  Hole 13 is a par 3 that plays across a gorge to a level fairway and green. 
Hole 14 drops 50 feet from tee to fairway, green is bunkered.  Hole number 15 plays back across the creek to a flat green...
